firstOccurrence.englishText: Yahweh God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

majorEvents.label: Blood witness
majorEvents.evidenceText: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

majorEvents.label: Offering
majorEvents.evidenceText: Noah built an altar to Yahweh, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

majorEvents.label: Genealogy
majorEvents.evidenceText: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

majorEvents.label: Birth or introduction
majorEvents.evidenceText: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for Yahweh will destroy the city!”

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

majorEvents.label: Offering
majorEvents.evidenceText: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

majorEvents.label: Offering
majorEvents.evidenceText: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.
